subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR require visible latest-head legacy-upgrade proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the current source/test proof for the no-code SQLite fallback?
rationale: The code path is plausible and covered by tests, but it changes runtime upgrade behavior for persisted diagnostics and the latest contributor update still does not visibly prove the legacy no-code SQLite row in a real setup.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the focused source proof and regression tests as enough for the upgraded persisted-state path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Out Of Runtime
options.body: If runtime invalidation for legacy no-code rows is not acceptable, pause this PR and move that cleanup into doctor or migration-owned code.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the predecessor's explicit-marker direction and merged recent plugin registry work in this boundary.
